body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

However, [I couldn't reproduce the original bug](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/114900#issuecomment-3747451461), so additional testing is needed.

Here are macOS arm64 release export template binaries for testing:

- `master`: [114937_master.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24604062/114937_master.zip)
- This PR: [114937_pr.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24604063/114937_pr.zip)

SCons options used for both binaries:

```
target=template_release optimize=speed disable_path_overrides=no
```
I can't reproduce the issue (M4 Pro, release template build), but using release-acquire ordering seems to make sense.
